title: console: a page or list view whose label is an inline locale map shows a machine name (InterfaceListPage) or reaches viewTabLabel raw (AppHeader view branch, ObjectView tab bar)
body:
Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 4 from two out-of-scope findings on objectui#13488 (dev report `6393426684`, PR objectstack-ai/objectui#13501). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route. Both were read from code on `main` `85b6a48`. Neither has been measured in a running console.

`@objectstack/spec` types a page's `label` / `description` and a `ListView`'s `label` as `I18nLabel` (`string | { [locale]: string }`). objectui#13470 and objectstack-ai/objectui#13488 fixed the report, page and dashboard surfaces that drew such a map raw. Two more readers have the same shape:

1. **`InterfaceListPage`** reads `typeof page.label === 'string' ? page.label : page.name` for its heading and record-drawer title, and draws `page.description` only when it is a string. So a page with a map label shows its machine name, and a map description is dropped. This is not a blank route, just the wrong text.
2. **AppHeader's view branch** passes `viewDef.label` to `viewTabLabel`, and **`ObjectView`'s tab bar** passes the same label to the same function. Whether a map view label blanks the view route depends on what `viewTabLabel` and `ObjectView` do with a non-string. The dev did not probe it.

**Expected:** resolve the map in the viewer's language the way objectstack-ai/objectui#13501 does (`metadataText` in app-shell, `pickLocalized` in components), with the machine name as the fallback only when no label resolves.

Dedupe words searched by the dev: "interface page label inline locale machine name InterfaceListPage", "view label inline locale map viewTabLabel ObjectView tab React 31".
